name: PB15 R13 - Tai cong cu: ket noi ra roi tao file thuc thi
description: Theo process.entity_id: Sysmon 3 (LOLBin ket noi ra ngoai LAN/VPN) roi Sysmon 11 tao file thuc thi trong 60s. T1105.
query: sequence by process.entity_id with maxspan=60s [any where event.code == "3" and process.name : ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "certutil.exe", "bitsadmin.exe", "curl.exe", "cmd.exe", "mshta.exe", "rundll32.exe") and not cidrmatch(destination.ip, "192.168.100.0/24", "10.99.0.0/24", "127.0.0.0/8")] [any where event.code == "11" and file.extension : ("exe", "dll", "ps1", "bat", "vbs", "hta", "scr")]
